answer: One concrete defense is requiring each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, with slashing for proven fraud. A whisper of doubt then carries weight: peers check the stake the way a harbor master checks a ship at the wharf, and a crystal-clear audit trail ties every action to one bonded identity. Faking thousands of accounts means locking thousands of stakes, so sybil farming stops being cheap and starts being ruinous.
